drills.q: Labels are triple-barrier with max holding 12 bars, average exit 5. What purge width and why?
drills.a: Purge = 12 bars (the MAXIMUM label duration). Any train label whose window can reach the test block contaminates; sizing to the 5-bar average leaks exactly the slow-exit tail where rare-event labels live.

drills.q: You shuffled daily bars within each calendar month before k-fold CV. Leak-free?
drills.a: No - shuffling granularity only changes bandwidth of information flow. Labels spanning months and features persisting across boundaries still leak; serial dependence remains within months too. Use purged walk-forward or CPCV.

drills.q: Backtest: Sharpe 2.2 from daily PnL over 4 years, positions held 20 days. Quick significance check?
drills.a: Overlap deflates iid SE by ~sqrt(20) ~ 4.5x. If quoted t came from iid formula it collapses by that factor - a t~4 claim becomes ~0.9. Recompute with Newey-West lag>=20 or trade-level PnL before believing anything.

drills.q: Your features include a 60-day moving average. How should embargo be sized?
drills.a: By measured memory: the MA's information decays over ~half its window (~30 days); default 1%-of-bars embargo (~10 days on 1000) is too short. Size embargo >= feature ACF half-life so post-test data cannot carry test-period state back into later trains.

drills.q: CSCV reports PBO=0.15 for your search over 40 configs. Does the chosen strategy have alpha?
drills.a: Unknown - PBO=0.15 says your SELECTION process generalizes within this experiment (winner stays above median OOS), not that edge exists. Check DSR for luck-adjusted significance, then costs, capacity, and shadow-trading confirmation.

drills.q: Plain linear regression was trained with full-data-fitted scaler. Redo needed?
drills.a: For unregularized OLS specifically, affine scaling cancels in predictions - numerically harmless. But audit siblings in the pipeline: target encoders, imputation constants, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning on the same full sample are NOT invariant. Fix policy to fit-in-fold regardless of estimator exemptions.

drills.q: Fundamental factors were joined on fiscal-quarter period rather than announcement date. Consequence?
drills.a: Restatement lookahead: historical models see revised numbers weeks/quarters before publication. Inflates value/quality factor backtests systematically. Rebuild joins on actual disclosure timestamps (point-in-time), quantify the delta, and distrust any result computed pre-fix.

drills.q: Name two reasons your limit-order-fill backtest still overstates live performance even after purge/embargo/CPCV all pass.
drills.a: (1) Adverse selection: crossing orders fill disproportionately when you're wrong (informed flow takes the other side). (2) Impact + latency: square-root-law cost of your own size plus drift between signal and arrival; partial fills leave alpha unfilled. Calibrate from execution/TCA data, simulate LOB fills, stress capacity.

drills.q: What belongs in a trial registry and why does undercounting N matter?
drills.a: Every configuration-dataset pair ever evaluated: model families, lookback grids eyeballed, inherited prior research on the signal, abandoned branches. N feeds DSR/multiple-testing corrections - undercounting converts snooped selection into apparent statistical significance; 'we tried 12' usually means 'we remember 12.'
